# FPGA-USB-Device source provenance

Source: https://github.com/WangXuan95/FPGA-USB-Device

Fixed commit: `ebf0696f0b1dc604a4ed8eedee4c3eae1643e66f` (upstream commit message: "change license to LGPL"). Author/project: WangXuan95.

The selected `RTL/usb_class/usb_serial_top.v`, complete `RTL/usbfs_core/` dependency tree, upstream README, and full LGPL version 2.1 LICENSE are copied byte-for-byte. `SOURCE.json` records each source hash. No vendor RTL is modified. FPGA examples for other vendors and unrelated device classes are omitted; the integration and bus tests are in `../../usb1_device/`.

Keep these notices, license and corresponding HDL source with any redistribution of this core or derived works. This local bring-up does not grant a production USB VID/PID: the upstream experimental `FB9A:FB9A` identification is retained solely to make this test image identifiable.
